title: Molecular-interaction foundation model yields de novo compounds validated in wet-lab tests
summary: The Bonbon foundation model, trained on about 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand data, reported a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families. The abstract describes structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets. This is a preprint, and assay details and the hit definition were not reviewed.
